stimulus_text: Appoint a security lead.
Plans should be inclusive and accessible for learners with SEND.
Provide strobe alarms for occupants who cannot hear audible alerts.
On hearing the alarm, evacuate via the nearest exit.
If escape is possible, run; otherwise hide.
Remain silent until released.
Follow RUN HIDE TELL.
Personal emergency evacuation plans should be in place for those who need them.
Verify by drill that occupants with mobility limitations can reach the secure area within the target time.
Conduct familiarisation drills so staff know the lockdown announcement.
Revise the procedure using findings from the annual drill review.
Exercise findings may inform plan updates.
Use the physical security assessment tool to review campus layers.
Teaching establishments especially destined for persons who cannot self-evacuate are in scope regardless of size.
Staff shall participate in the plan according to their capacities.
Call emergency services and report your location if safe.
Keep hands visible and empty; do not run toward officers.
Try to stay calm.
Staff should report concerning behaviour to the threat-assessment team.
Consider individual needs during drills.
Assign buddies/marshals to assist learners who need support during evacuation.
A PA lockdown message should prompt students to close and lock doors and move to safe areas.
After a drill revealed an inaccessible egress route, the college amended its plan with reasonable adjustments.
School violence is a serious concern.
Remain secured until released by law enforcement, which may be prolonged.
Attention should be paid to pupils with disabilities and those with personalised reception plans during exercises.
Identify alarm signals, routes, and secure locations as common procedures.
Distinguish threat behaviour from disability-related behaviour known for the student.
The planning team should include a special-education professional when assessing threat referrals.
Settings should test their protective plans using practice drills, taking individual trauma into account.
Keep noise down during the drill.
Barricade the door with heavy furniture.
